d: Please read this before you apply. It's commission only. There's no base salary, no retainer and no fixed monthly fee, so you earn a commission on each client contract you bring in . And it's 100% work from home. No office, no commute.

ONG Consulting Services is a Bahrain-based technical advisory firm serving the pipeline, energy and infrastructure sectors. Our services cover hydraulic assessment and optimization, flow assurance, operational integrity, risk assessment and HAZOP facilitation, project management advisory, and technical training programs.
This is an independent, commission-based contract. You'll work remotely, from anywhere and on your own schedule. You're paid on results only.
r: Find and qualify new clients in the GCC
Open doors and set up introductory meetings
Work with our technical lead to shape proposals, presentations and commercial offers
Keep your pipeline up to date in our CRM and report progress every two weeks
Track industry news, tenders and upcoming projects that fit our services
Commission only, paid as a percentage of the contract value you close
No base salary, allowance or expense reimbursement
Full commission terms are shared with shortlisted candidates before any agreement is signed
This suits an established business developer who already knows the players in GCC oil, gas or infrastructure and wants an extra income stream on flexible terms.

A proven record of winning new business in technical or professional services

d: Anantara Hotels & Resorts is a global luxury hotel and resort brand rooted in Thai culture, with an intrinsic sense of authentic hospitality. Inspired by the Sanskrit word meaning ‘without end’, our spirit embodies freedom, movement, and harmony. We believe every journey should leave a lasting impression — for our guests and for our people.

Founded in 2001 in Thailand, we have since expanded across the world, welcoming guests in some of the world’s most captivating locales — from pristine beaches and private islands to ancient sites and vibrant metropolises. If you are driven by a passion for generosity, warmth and heartfelt hospitality, Anantara offers a career without limits.

The HVAC Technician is responsible for the installation, operation, inspection, maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair of the hotel's heating, ventilation, air conditioning, and refrigeration systems to ensure efficient, safe, and reliable operation.
Carry out daily inspections of HVAC and refrigeration equipment and systems.
Perform preventive and corrective maintenance on air conditioning and ventilation systems.
Troubleshoot and repair HVAC equipment, including split units, FCUs, AHUs, chillers, pumps, and ventilation systems.
Monitor and maintain proper temperature and humidity levels throughout the hotel.
Check refrigerant levels, pressures, compressors, motors, filters, belts, coils, and other HVAC components.
Identify and repair refrigerant leaks and other system faults.
Clean and maintain filters, coils, drain pans, ducts, and other HVAC components.
Respond promptly to maintenance requests and HVAC breakdowns, particularly in guest rooms and critical hotel areas.
Carry out routine checks and maintenance of refrigeration equipment, including refrigerators, freezers, and cold rooms where applicable.
Assist with the installation, testing, and commissioning of new HVAC equipment.
Maintain accurate records of preventive maintenance, repairs, inspections, and equipment performance.
Ensure all tools, equipment, and spare parts are properly maintained and safely stored.
Coordinate with other Engineering team members and departments to minimize disruption to hotel operations.
Report major equipment faults, recurring problems, and required spare parts to the Engineering Supervisor or Chief Engineer.
Follow all hotel safety, environmental, and energy-conservation procedures.
Ensure proper handling, storage, and disposal of refrigerants and other technical materials in accordance with applicable regulations.
Maintain a clean and safe working environment.
Assist other Engineering team members with general maintenance duties when required.
Perform any other duties assigned by the Chief Engineer or Engineering management.

Company Description MyFatoorah is the Middle East’s leading payment gateway, providing smart payment solutions for modern businesses. The company offers seamless online transaction processing and instant invoicing to help enterprises manage payments efficiently. Its secure platform integrates with major banks to accelerate settlements and streamline financial operations. Thousands of businesses across the region rely on MyFatoorah to enhance their payment experience and support sustainable growth. Joining MyFatoorah means contributing to innovative fintech solutions that shape the future of digital payments.

Role Description The Junior Customer Service (CS) role is a full-time, on-site position based in Kuwait City. The role involves responding to customer inquiries through phone, email, and chat, providing accurate information about MyFatoorah’s payment services and resolving basic technical and account-related issues. The Junior CS team member will log and track cases, escalate complex issues to senior staff, and follow up to ensure timely resolution. Daily tasks include guiding clients through platform features, assisting with onboarding and account setup, and coordinating with internal teams such as operations and technical support. The role also includes maintaining updated knowledge of MyFatoorah products, documenting customer interactions, and contributing to a positive, professional customer experience.
q: Candidates should possess customer service and client support skills, including active listening, empathy, and clear, professional communication.
Candidates should possess basic technical and troubleshooting skills related to online payment platforms, web-based applications, and account configuration.
Candidates should possess organizational and administrative skills, such as case logging, data entry accuracy, and time management.
Candidates should possess problem-solving and analytical skills to identify issues, interpret customer needs, and propose practical solutions.
Candidates should possess teamwork and collaboration skills, with the ability to coordinate effectively with internal departments and follow shared processes.
Relevant qualifications include a diploma or bachelor’s degree in business, IT, finance, or a related field, or equivalent experience in a customer-facing role.
Proficiency in English is required; Arabic language skills and prior experience in fintech, banking, or payment gateways are advantageous.
Ability to work on-site in Kuwait City, maintain confidentiality, and handle high-volume inquiries with professionalism is essential.

d: Stock Coordinator is responsible for receiving, inspecting, storing merchandise and maintaining accurate stock levels, organizing merchandise, and ensuring the seamless flow of products from the stockroom to the sales floor. Stock Coordinator works closely with store management, sales associates, and other team members to uphold a high standard of organization.
q: The ideal Stock Coordinator in a retail company should have strong organizational Skills with familiarity with warehouse management system to keep track and manage stock. Previous experience in a similar stock, warehouse, or logistics role is preferred.
r: Receive merchandize and count it physically and electronically in order to ensure accuracy of information
Inspect the quality of the products and report the discrepancies to store manager / assistant store manager about damaged products.
Ensure proper storage and handling of merchandise to prevent damage.
Classify and stock the products in the stock room as per the store procedures to ensure quick availability of the product.
Tag the newly arrived stock and / or return the products as per the instruction of senior
Assist the sales staff in replenishing stocks on the shelves in order to ensure availability of products at all times
Ensure awareness and vigilance at all times of security in the store without any negligence
Ensure the highest standards of housekeeping standards
Flexible to work for extended hours during the Sale / Festival period
Must be physically fit and ability of heavy lifting of around 10kgs of weight.
Record the inventory inward / outward and maintain the report of the same
Check for missing price tags and report the same
